> **PR title must follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/):**
> `feat: add X` · `fix: correct Y` · `chore: update Z` · `docs: ...` · `test: ...` · `refactor: ...`
>
> ⚠️ A generic title like **"Dev"** will fail the CI check **and** produce no release.
> The PR title becomes the commit message on `main` — release-please reads it to decide the version bump.
